title: Native Instruments 216: Traktor DJ For iPad - 11. Understanding Beat Matching
author: Hollin Jones / macProVideo
method: Targeted adjacent-frame review of paused public YouTube playback. Retained native full-screen captures after excluding a variable-layout browser screenshot pass. No continuous audiovisual review of the complete lesson.

coverage.play_region_review: Every retained frame via contact sheets

orange_indicator_faded_by.note: Approximate visual fade end, not finger release

findings.orange_indicator: One uninterrupted visible event with expanding rings and fade. No clearly separate reappearance or renewed pulse before source scrolling.
findings.marker: Forward progress toward source start, with no visible restart in inspected strip.

limitations: On-screen indicator is not a raw touch log or a physical finger view.
First clear green precedes indicator onset by three reviewed steps, about 0.10 s. Indicator timing is uncalibrated.
Solid orange indicator obscures underlying Play state during part of the lead-in.
YouTube timeline crosses the lower part of the button in some frames; main triangle remains readable.
Count-in annotation covers part of left waveform.
Video UI timestamps are not audio onset, input latency or sample-accurate clock measurements.
Quantize Size is not shown or changed; no cancellation trial established.
